      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.mem_finiteDimensionalResidual_iff (k : Type u) [Field k] (B : Type u) [Ring B] [Algebra k B] (b : B) :
      b ∈ finiteDimensionalResidual k B ↔ ∀ (M : ModuleCat B), Module.Finite k ↑M → ∀ (x : ↑M), b • x = 0

      Equivalently, the residual ideal is the common annihilator of all finite-dimensional modules.
